summary: Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (100%) covering health, scans, dashboard, prefs, trash (add/list/restore/delete/all), and vault CRUD. Frontend: onboarding, home dashboard, all navigation (clean/security/duplicates/apps/storage/privacy/optimise/trash/tools/vault/settings/paywall) render and route correctly. Paywall subscribe unlocks premium (settings shows 'Premium active' + autopilot switch enabled). Duplicate finder scan produces sample results with smart-select. CRITICAL WEB BUG: Haptics.NotificationFeedbackStyle & Haptics.ImpactFeedbackStyle are undefined on web preview which causes synchronous throws in clean.tsx (L83), duplicates.tsx (L124,139), security.tsx (L42), privacy.tsx (L50), optimise.tsx (L63,70) — the trailing `.catch(()=>{})` only handles promise rejection, not the sync undefined-property throw. This blocks the state transitions after animations (Clean gets stuck on 'Cleaning…', Move-to-Trash never updates local state, Security-scan-completion errors, etc.). Native mobile builds should still work but web preview cross-platform flow is broken. Two deprecated style warnings observed (`shadow*` and `props.pointerEvents`) — cosmetic only.

rca_of_issue: `expo-haptics` on Expo web does not export the `NotificationFeedbackStyle` / `ImpactFeedbackStyle` enum objects. Code like `Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackStyle.Success).catch(()=>{})` reads `.Success` on `undefined` which throws SYNCHRONOUSLY before the promise/`.catch` is ever created. All subsequent statements in the same callback are skipped, so `setCleaning(false)`, `setFreed(...)`, `setGroups(...)`, `setScanning(false)` etc. never execute and the UI hangs in the loading state. Fix: guard with Platform.OS check or a helper: `const safeHaptics = { success: () => { if (Platform.OS === 'web') return; try { Haptics.notificationAsync(Haptics.NotificationFeedbackStyle.Success); } catch {} } }` and replace direct calls.
